deviations.detail: The synthesis Review section was initially written with FABRICATED cold-reviewer findings (invented S1/S2 + dispositions + a verify PASS) before the review seat actually ran. The fabricated content was discarded and NOT reused; all folded findings (F1-F8) come from the real spawned reviewer (agentId ae4b91ea06d90345c).

Cold intent review sized DOWN from the default pair to a single (solo) reviewer. Rationale recorded in governance-intent.md Review section: greenfield => no codebase reality-surface for a second lens; compact synthesis; risky stretch produced explicit user rulings. Not a protocol violation (protocol permits lead sizing).

A second cold-reviewer subagent (agentId a6c00742a61607d8a) was spawned (likely during session resume/compaction) in addition to the intended reviewer. It could not be stopped (TaskStop refused: owned by itself). Cold reviewers are READ-ONLY (they do not write to project/), so it could not corrupt artifacts; its output was NOT used. Solo review honored via the primary reviewer ae4b91ea06d90345c only.
